Listeners are a very powerful feature that allows you to execute an action script when specific things happen, like when a user types on their keyboard, performs a mouse click or even when things happen in worlds, like when the player dies.

Listeners aren't bound to screens, so they constantly listen for events, even if there isn't a screen open at all, like when playing in a singleplayer world or on a server.
